    "Seamless file sharing for design assets and mockups."

  "cons": [
    "Potential for notification overload and distraction.",
    "Important information can get lost in busy channels without careful management.",
    "Lacks advanced project tracking features of dedicated PM tools."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Senior Creative likely experienced Slack as an indispensable communication tool, highly effective for coordinating design projects and engaging with clients. They valued its ability to streamline real-time feedback and keep project conversations organized within a small team environment. While generally positive, the user might have occasionally found it challenging to manage notification volume or retrieve specific decisions from extensive chat histories."
